crossRefs.note: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.
The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
“But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?
The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
“Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk…
“Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found, and hid. In his joy, he goes and…
who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.
Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord…
I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe…
For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange…
except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.
considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.
They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life…

translations.web: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
translations.bsb: Invest in truth and never sell it— in wisdom and instruction and understanding.
translations.kjv: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
translations.asv: Buy the truth, and sell it not; Yea, wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
